<thought>Using the ESI‑MS peak at m/z 141.115 (assumed [M+H]⁺) gives a neutral mass of ≈140.108 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely with C, H, O and one other element (X) is C₈H₁₄NO (exact mass 140.1075 Da). This fits within the experimental tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14NO</final_answer>
